name: Foundations of Visual Computing
description: Introduction to images; image understanding, image processing, and image generation; sampling and representation; visual perception; image reconstruction; image filters and features; 3D space and transformations; camera models; tracking and pose estimation; lighting and shading; introduction to AR/VR; data visualization and communicating with images.
